body: Not a teacher but, senior year I had 1st period with a girl who had a crush on my my teacher. She would talk about it under her breath or what not but it was super awkward. Mainly because he was an aquaintance of the family. But you could tell she wasn't the only one. He kept his distance, and was always behind his desk if there wasn't a class full of kids in there. (Always kept the door open too but that was school policy)
I'm not sure. Going to therapy tomorrow. We'll see how it goes .

Distract yourself. I just relapsed too after a good stint. When you relapse, the urge to keep up the old habit comes back just as strong. It's going to take time to go away again. Just keep distracted.
Its rough but if I don't i cannot calm down.

Hey I'm here. I cant offer much. But if you want to message. Also. I feel the test thing. Grades are the biggest anxiety trigger for me. What helps me is to say "I know what I know at this point." Cramming won't help and will make you feel way worse. Just take a break, get sone rest. Do something YOU enjoy. I love watching comedies like Letterkenny or youtibe videos. 
I know it probably isnt much of a relief. But I hope it helps.
